publish.description: What Marcus Aurelius wrote to himself, and why we still read it.

scenes.headline: A Roman emperor's private notes
scenes.narration: Two thousand years ago, a Roman emperor wrote notes to himself. We still read them.

scenes.headline: Written for himself
scenes.narration: Meditations are the private notes of Marcus Aurelius, Roman emperor from 161 to 180. He wrote them in Greek as a source for his own guidance and self-improvement.

scenes.headline: Recurring themes
scenes.narration: Focus on what is in your control, control your emotions, remember that everything comes from nature and returns to it, and stay focused and ethical.
items: Focus on what is in your control

scenes.headline: Stoic practice
scenes.narration: He was a Stoic, and the notes read like reminders to himself: stay calm, stay fair, stay useful.

scenes.headline: Try one page
scenes.narration: Read one page tonight and see what stays with you.
